# Slides

> Free host for AI-made HTML/CSS/JS presentation decks. No account required to publish. Sign in to choose a custom /d/<name>/ URL.

Production: https://slides.availabooks.com
Source: https://github.com/availabooks/slides

## Agent skill (includes CLI)

The skill folder is the whole package: markdown + a zero-dependency Node CLI.

- [slides skill](https://slides.availabooks.com/skills/slides/SKILL.md)
- [slides.mjs CLI](https://slides.availabooks.com/skills/slides/slides.mjs)
- [slides.zip](https://slides.availabooks.com/skills/slides.zip) — full skill folder (`SKILL.md`, `slides.mjs`, `package.json`)

Load the skill whenever you need to host or share HTML/CSS/JS slides (Reveal.js, impress.js, or hand-written decks), including custom slugs after Magic Auth.

Decks that use `#deck > .slide` (or `.deck > section`) automatically get mobile swipe, shareable `#n` links, and a thumbnail jumper. Reveal.js keeps its own `#/n` + overview. See the skill.

    curl -fsSL -o slides.zip https://slides.availabooks.com/skills/slides.zip
    unzip slides.zip
    node slides/slides.mjs upload deck.html --slug my-talk

## Quick start

POST https://slides.availabooks.com/api/upload as multipart form data.

    curl -sS -X POST https://slides.availabooks.com/api/upload \
      -F mode=paste \
      -F html=@deck.html

Success (201): `{ "id", "slug", "url" }`. Give the user `url` (example `https://slides.availabooks.com/d/<id>/`).

Modes: `paste` (field `html`), `files` (repeat field `files`, include `index.html`), `zip` (field `zip`). Max ~10MB. No API key.

Custom `/d/<name>/` URLs: sign the user in with Magic Auth (`POST /api/auth/magic/start` then `verify`), then upload with `Authorization: Bearer <session>` and form field `slug`. Never invent the 6-digit email code. Prefer the bundled CLI (`slides.mjs`) for that flow.

Do not invent other publish APIs. Do not call WorkOS directly.
